discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology went from basic peptide discovery to drugs that changed how diabetes and obesity are treated. It has won the 2024 Lasker Award, the Breakthrough Prize and the Gairdner, and its effects on cardiovascular and kidney outcomes are now established. The committee went to immunology in 2025 and to RNA biology in 2023 and 2024, so a metabolic and physiological discovery fits as the next choice.
